[quote][font=Georgia][size=4]Dear Farmer,

I've spent way more time painstakingly scrutinizing every pixel of this than I probably should have.
But it's only my second pixelsmithing project, and I'm really happy with the final result.

I thought having the idle animation as little blinking parking lights was a cute immersive touch.
But it is quite erratic on when it decides to blink, particularly when the tractor faces north.

If you really don't like the effect, open config.json and change "On" to "Off".
You can also do this in game with the Generic Mod Configuration Menu mod.

To install, use Vortex or another mod manager and it'll do it all for you.
Or manually, drop the folder from the zip into your "\mods" folder.

Props to paritee who has already done a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3350]John Deere[/url] recolouring.
Which gave me the inspiration to create this.

I hope you know that you are all appreciated. [color=#ff00ff]<3[/color]

[i]- Lily[/i]

P.S. Also check out my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6939]Rustic Tractor Garage[/url]![/size][/font][/quote]
